entities.summary: Yaroslav the Wise's golden age: construction of Saint Sophia Cathedral (Kyiv), the Ruska Pravda law code, diplomatic marriages connecting Kyiv to European royal houses, and Kyiv's status as one of Europe's largest and wealthiest cities.
